name: Astarte
source:
Canaan's most loved one and a good friend of Baal, the ruler of rains. Though born to be the most beautiful and adored by her people, Astarte found said gift to be a shackle that bind her, and sought to find a way to prove that she herself can be strong like everyone else as well.

[spoiler]She is Astaroth's past life that reincarnated into the world of Gehenna following Canaan's destruction at the hand of Eden.[/spoiler]
